comments.text: Corrections (from citizen): A: It's only on Svalbard, archipelago further North in Arctic Sea, where people aren't allowed to be buried. (For several reasons, climate/permafrost being one.) In mainland Norway burials also in the ground, are allowed and always has been. Due to cruise ship traffic from frequent and very large cruise ships. Sends vibrations from very large engines through the ground, etc. which transplants into the small wooden houses. In general the cruise ship trafgic which has increased a lot in recent years along the entire Norw. coast now needs to be de reased considerably, as it is also putting far too much pressure on other cities, e.g. Bergen. Where up to 3 large cruise ships dock per day, meaning thousands of tourist go ashore simultaneously in a relatively  small old city centre, making it into a less nice old cith centra for all, and in particular for inhabitants. Tourists should feel welcome and come to a natural city, not a 'tourist machine.' WHOSE DECISION was it to increase the cruise ship traffic to as much as we see currently? A formal decision made by a previous government. Without any noticeable general public debate about this. WAS THE governm. under any pressure from someone within the EU/EU Commission or other 'forces' to do this? It doesn't matter much: it is the governm. of the country's job to protect the popul. and manage the country's resources well enough, and in acc. with rules & regul. In this matter (also) they have failed.

replies.author: @skiandsea-m
replies.text: (contd. comment.) C: The video has managed somehow to avoid all the beautiful landscapes, esp. along the Norw. coast, which are now destroyed by wind farms. Thus destroying parts of, or all of, the protected lands. (dramatically negative), fisheries, vital fish populat., demands anything BUT further pressure on and in the seas. Not least from offshore wind f.which are not even CLOSE to being safely assessed for the marine environment they are to be built and placed in. The current weakness and too undemocratic forms of governing from our governm. these days is not in any way sustainable.
